$comment: One schema for both sides of a person record behind human-attested crosswalk evidence: public records in _data/attestations.json (people who agreed to be published) and private records in the maintainers' private repository. Field meanings are documented at https://fossfoundation.info/crosswalk#people. Vocabularies: Schema.org Person https://schema.org/Person and OrganizationRole https://schema.org/OrganizationRole, Dublin Core https://www.dublincore.org/specifications/dublin-core/dcmi-terms/. Consent fields record what a controller must be able to show under GDPR Art. 7(1) https://gdpr-info.eu/art-7-gdpr/.
title: Attestation Person Records Schema
description: People at a foundation who confirmed, out of band to a trusted attestor, that an account or package belongs to that foundation. Crosswalk evidence points to a record by its opaque identifier (confirmedWith.identifier), so contact details can stay private. Add records with `fdncrosswalk add-person`.

identifier.title: Opaque identifier
identifier.description: A random UUID as a URN, the same value as confirmedWith.identifier in crosswalk evidence. Never derived from the person's email or name, so it cannot be used to look them up. urn:uuid:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 is reserved for test records. Never reuse an identifier for a different person.
identifier.$comment: Schema.org identifier: https://schema.org/identifier; UUID URN: RFC 9562 https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9562

visibility.title: Visibility
visibility.description: public: stored in this public repository's _data/attestations.json, because the person agreed to have their details published (consent.publish must be true). private: stored only in the maintainers' private repository.

testRecord.title: Test record
testRecord.description: True for example data that refers to no real person.

name.title: Name
name.description: The person's name. Optional; leave it out if they prefer.

email.title: Email
email.description: The person's email address, preferably at the foundation's own domain.

roleName.title: Role
roleName.description: The person's role at the organization when they confirmed, for example VP Infrastructure. Also copied into the public crosswalk evidence.
roleName.$comment: Schema.org roleName on an OrganizationRole: https://schema.org/roleName

memberOf.title: Organization
memberOf.description: Identifier of the organization the role is at: the file name of a _foundations/<identifier>.md file.

recordedBy.title: Recorded by
recordedBy.description: GitHub login of the attestor who spoke with the person. Their attestations count as confirmed only if the login is listed in _data/attestors.json.

consent.title: Consent
consent.description: How and when the person agreed to us keeping (and, for public records, publishing) these details.
consent.$comment: GDPR Art. 7 conditions for consent: https://gdpr-info.eu/art-7-gdpr/

method.title: Method
method.description: How consent was given; the same values as the crosswalk evidence method (https://fossfoundation.info/crosswalk#evidence).

evidence.title: Where to find it
evidence.description: Where the consent can be found again, for example a mail archive link or ticket number. Do not paste the message itself.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.description: What the person agreed we may use the details for.

legalBasis.title: Legal basis
legalBasis.description: Link to the GDPR article relied on; normally Art. 6(1)(a), consent: https://gdpr-info.eu/art-6-gdpr/

publish.title: Agreed to publication
publish.description: True when the person agreed to have this record published in the public repository. Required for public records.

withdrawn.title: Date withdrawn
withdrawn.description: Date consent was withdrawn. Delete the record instead where possible (GDPR Art. 17: https://gdpr-info.eu/art-17-gdpr/).

retainUntil.title: Review by
retainUntil.description: Date to review whether the record is still needed; one year after it was recorded by default.

usedIn.title: Used in
usedIn.description: Crosswalk files whose evidence points at this identifier.
